answer: Linea proves EVM execution with a Vortex commitment, so the trace is bound to the proof. A farm needs 226 separate Linea proofs, since each one is bound to its own execution trace. The commitment is verified on-chain, and the proof must match the expected state root. The timber check runs in the open: 226 fakes pay the full price 226 times, one honest agent pays once, and the ivory trail in the ledger makes the walnut cost visible to everyone.
